narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in northern Burlington County during the early hours of August 10. Rainfall totals were up to 2 to 4 inches.
ev: Flooding occurred at interchange 52 on Interstate 295 in Mansfield Township. The northbound ramp to Columbus Road was closed. Also, US Route 206 southbound was closed at Hedding Road in Mansfield Township.
Flooding occurred on Interstate 295 southbound, to the south of Interchange 57 in Bordentown Township. All lanes were closed.
